web_context.competitor_activity: Humana (focused exclusively on Medicare Advantage) faces the steepest headwinds from stagnant MA reimbursement rates, benefiting UNH's diversified model. CVS Health/Aetna remains UNH's closest vertically-integrated rival. Elevance Health competes in commercial/Medicaid. Industry-wide, GLP-1 Medicare mandates raise medical cost ratio concerns for all insurers, but UNH's scale and AI-driven prior-authorization platform ('Value Connect', launched early 2026, cutting manual review 45%) offer competitive advantage.
